title: Overwatch 2
provenance: DXMT changelog v0.80 (github.com/3Shain/dxmt/releases). Measured here on an M4 with macOS 27.0 on 2026-10-01, the Steam copy with DXMT, up to Blizzard's account link screen. The game itself was not played. Played by yaoiboy5 (highball#232, 2026-10-05), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, after switching the environment to the Wine 11 engine: plays flawlessly, with a Battle.net account already linked to Steam. Played by vlbphotography (highball-db#340, 2026-10-05), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.3, on the Wine 11 engine r15 with DXMT: playable for 18 minutes, rated 3 of 5 for some frame drops. ArtemisDicoTiar (highball-db#706, 2026-10-26), Apple M4, macOS 26.6, Highball 0.10.22, the Wine 11 engine x64-crossover26.3-r25, DXMT, msync, the overwatch-2 recipe, rated 5 of 5 after 6 minutes.
notes: A player on an M5 Pro reports it plays flawlessly on the Wine 11 engine (highball#232), and the recipe makes Play offer that engine. On the Wine 11 engine (x64-crossover26.3-r12) the game opens and shows Blizzard's Battle.net account link screen, a QR code and a code to enter at blizzard.com/link, which a Steam player sees on a first start. The account was not linked here, so nothing past that screen was played. On the default engine (x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r17) the same copy runs for two minutes without ever opening a window, which is what players report (highball#232). The hang measured in September on engine r5, a load above 240 that buried the Mac, did not happen on either engine, the load stayed under 7. The DXMT changelog note still stands as an upstream claim (missing hero ability effects fixed, Battle.net required). Re-checked on 2026-10-05 on an M4 with the Wine 11 engine r15 and DXMT: the game opens full screen on its own desktop Space and shows Blizzard's Battle.net link screen (QR code), the first screen for a Steam account that is not linked yet. A second player, on an M4 with the Wine 11 engine r15 and DXMT, played 18 minutes with some frame drops (highball-db#340).

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles

knownIssues.symptom: On the default engine the game starts but never opens a window (highball#232)
knownIssues.cause: Not found yet. The same copy opens and reaches the account link screen on the Wine 11 engine. Measured on an M4 with macOS 27.0 on 2026-10-01, engines r17 and r12 with DXMT
knownIssues.fix: The recipe offers the Wine 11 engine (x64-crossover26.3-r15 or newer) on Play; switching by hand is the environment's full page, Advanced, Engine. A player confirmed it plays there (highball#232).

knownIssues.symptom: On engine r5 (September 2026) the Mac became unresponsive soon after launch, with no game window
knownIssues.cause: A repeating assertion failure inside the game, each one a Windows exception that is expensive under Rosetta. Measured 2026-09-09 on x64-crossover26.3-r5, load average above 240, back to 2 when the process was killed
knownIssues.fix: Did not happen on r12 or r17 in two minutes each on 2026-10-01. If it does, stop the environment from Highball and the Mac recovers at once
